displayName: Research Quality Gate（调研报告质量门禁）
description: This skill acts as a quality gate for research reports and intelligence briefs: it checks whether the evidence actually supports the conclusions, flags overreach and unsupported inference, and audits the evaluation method itself for bias. It also sets rules for multi-agent collaboration so findings stay traceable. Use when you need to review a report before it goes to decision-makers, or when a conclusion looks too neat to trust. 调研 / 情报产物的质量门禁与多 agent 协作规范，用于回答「这份调研报告靠不靠谱」「结论有没有过度推断」「怎么判断评估本身有没有偏」这类问题

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
